When to use: Please take me to Florence airport
Show to staff: Per favore, mi porti all’aeroporto di Firenze, alla zona partenze.
English translation: Please take me to Florence Airport, departures.

Show to staff: Ho prenotato un taxi. Dove devo aspettarlo?
English translation: I booked a taxi. Where should I wait?

Show to staff: Può chiamarmi un taxi ufficiale per l’aeroporto, per favore?
English translation: Could you call a licensed taxi to the airport?

When to use: I have a very early flight
Show to staff: Il mio volo parte molto presto. A che ora devo lasciare l’hotel?
English translation: My flight leaves very early. When should I leave the hotel?

Show to staff: Posso pagare con carta di credito?
English translation: Can I pay by credit card?

When to use: How much will the taxi cost?
Show to staff: Quanto costa la corsa fino all’aeroporto?
English translation: How much is the ride to the airport?

Show to staff: Ho un volo per Parigi e poi proseguo per Detroit e Cleveland.
English translation: I am flying to Paris, then Detroit and Cleveland.

Show to staff: Dov’è il banco del check-in per il mio volo per Parigi?
English translation: Where is check-in for my Paris flight?

Show to staff: Può stampare tutte le carte d’imbarco disponibili per il mio viaggio fino a Cleveland?
English translation: Can you print all available boarding passes to Cleveland?

Show to staff: Può confermare la destinazione finale del mio bagaglio registrato?
English translation: Can you confirm the final destination on my checked-bag tag?

Show to staff: Devo ritirare e registrare di nuovo il bagaglio a Detroit?
English translation: Will I need to collect and recheck my bag in Detroit?

Show to staff: Non riesco ad accedere alla mia carta d’imbarco. Può aiutarmi a stamparla?
English translation: I cannot access my boarding pass. Please help me print it.

Show to staff: Dove si trovano i controlli di sicurezza?
English translation: Where is security screening?

Show to staff: Non trovo il mio gate. Può indicarmi la strada?
English translation: I cannot find my gate. Can you show me?

Show to staff: È questa la fila giusta per il mio volo?
English translation: Is this the correct line for my flight?

Show to staff: Sono in difficoltà e viaggio da solo. Può aiutarmi, per favore?
English translation: I need assistance and am traveling alone. Could you help me?

Show to staff: Rischio di perdere il volo. Può aiutarmi subito a trovare il banco della compagnia aerea?
English translation: I may miss my flight. Please help me find my airline desk now.

Show to staff: Il mio volo è stato cancellato. Dove posso farmi riprenotare?
English translation: My flight was canceled. Where can I get rebooked?

Show to staff: Non trovo la mia valigia. Dove si trova l’ufficio bagagli smarriti?
English translation: I cannot find my suitcase. Where is baggage services?

Show to staff: Il mio telefono non funziona e non ho accesso a Internet. Può aiutarmi?
English translation: My phone is not working and I have no internet. Can you help?

Show to staff: Ho perso il passaporto. Mi può aiutare a contattare la polizia aeroportuale?
English translation: I lost my passport. Please help me contact airport police.

Show to staff: Ho bisogno di assistenza medica, per favore.
English translation: I need medical assistance, please.

Show to staff: Non parlo bene italiano. Può parlare lentamente o scrivere le istruzioni?
English translation: I do not speak Italian well. Please speak slowly or write instructions.

When to use: I have a connection to Detroit
Show to staff: Je suis en correspondance pour Détroit, puis Cleveland. Où dois-je aller ?
English translation: I am connecting to Detroit, then Cleveland. Where should I go?

Show to staff: Où se trouve le parcours des correspondances ?
English translation: Where is the flight connections route?

Show to staff: Je suis en transit. Je ne veux pas sortir de l’aéroport. Quel chemin dois-je suivre ?
English translation: I am connecting and do not want to exit the airport. Which way?

Show to staff: Où se trouve le contrôle des passeports pour les vols vers les États-Unis ?
English translation: Where is passport control for U.S. flights?

Show to staff: Dois-je passer un contrôle de sécurité ? Où dois-je aller ?
English translation: Do I need security screening, and where is it?

Show to staff: Quel est le terminal de mon vol pour Détroit ?
English translation: Which terminal is my flight to Detroit in?

Show to staff: Je ne trouve pas ma porte d’embarquement. Pouvez-vous me montrer le chemin ?
English translation: I cannot find my boarding gate. Please show me the way.

Show to staff: Cette navette va-t-elle au terminal de mon vol pour Détroit ?
English translation: Does this shuttle go to my Detroit departure terminal?

Show to staff: Est-ce la bonne file pour mon vol vers Détroit ?
English translation: Is this the right line for my Detroit flight?

Show to staff: Mon vol pour Détroit est-il à l’heure ? À quelle porte dois-je aller ?
English translation: Is my Detroit flight on time? Which gate?

Show to staff: Ma correspondance est très courte. Je risque de manquer mon vol. Aidez-moi, s’il vous plaît.
English translation: My connection is tight. I may miss the flight. Please help.

Show to staff: J’ai manqué ma correspondance. Où se trouve le comptoir de transfert de ma compagnie aérienne ?
English translation: I missed my connection. Where is my airline transfer desk?

Show to staff: Mon vol a été annulé. Pouvez-vous m’aider à obtenir un autre vol vers Cleveland ?
English translation: My flight is canceled. Can you help rebook me to Cleveland?

Show to staff: Pouvez-vous confirmer tous mes vols jusqu’à Cleveland et m’indiquer les nouvelles portes ?
English translation: Can you confirm all flights to Cleveland and the new gates?

When to use: What happens to my checked bag?
Show to staff: Où se trouve mon bagage enregistré ? Suivra-t-il mon nouvel itinéraire ?
English translation: Where is my checked luggage? Will it follow my new itinerary?

Show to staff: Je n’ai pas ma carte d’embarquement. Pouvez-vous l’imprimer ?
English translation: I do not have my boarding pass. Can you print it?

Show to staff: Je voyage seul et je suis perdu. Pouvez-vous m’indiquer exactement où aller ?
English translation: I am traveling alone and lost. Please tell me exactly where to go.

Show to staff: Je ne parle pas français. Parlez-vous anglais ? Sinon, pouvez-vous parler lentement ?
English translation: I do not speak French. Do you speak English, or can you speak slowly?

Show to staff: Mon téléphone ne fonctionne pas et je n’ai pas Internet. Pouvez-vous m’aider ?
English translation: My phone does not work and I have no internet. Please help.

Show to staff: J’ai perdu mon passeport. Pouvez-vous m’aider à contacter la police de l’aéroport ?
English translation: I lost my passport. Please help me contact airport police.

Show to staff: J’ai besoin d’une assistance médicale immédiate, s’il vous plaît.
English translation: I need immediate medical help, please.

Show to staff: Où sont les toilettes les plus proches ?
English translation: Where is the nearest restroom?

Show to staff: Dove si trova il banco check-in di Air France per il volo per Parigi?
English translation: Where is Air France check-in for the flight to Paris?

When to use: Is this the line for my flight?
Show to staff: È questa la fila giusta per il volo Air France per Parigi delle 6:50?
English translation: Is this the correct line for the 6:50 Air France flight to Paris?

Show to staff: Il mio itinerario prosegue da Parigi a Detroit e Cleveland. Può controllare fino a dove viene registrato il mio bagaglio?
English translation: I connect through Paris and Detroit to Cleveland. Please confirm my bag’s checked destination.

When to use: Where will I collect my bag?
Show to staff: Devo ritirare il bagaglio a Parigi oppure a Detroit? Può verificare l’etichetta?
English translation: Do I collect my luggage in Paris or Detroit? Please verify the bag tag.

Show to staff: Può verificare i miei tre voli e dirmi come ottenere tutte le carte d’imbarco?
English translation: Please check all three flights and tell me how to get all boarding passes.

Show to staff: Dove si trova il controllo di sicurezza per le partenze?
English translation: Where is departure security?

Show to staff: Qual è il gate del mio volo per Parigi? È cambiato?
English translation: What is my gate for Paris? Has it changed?

Show to staff: Il mio volo per Parigi è in ritardo. Riuscirò a prendere la coincidenza per Detroit?
English translation: My flight to Paris is delayed. Will I make my Detroit connection?

Show to staff: Può scrivermi il numero del gate e le indicazioni, per favore?
English translation: Please write down my gate and directions.

Show to staff: Il mio bagaglio non è arrivato. Dove posso fare la denuncia?
English translation: My checked bag is missing. Where do I report it?

Show to staff: Je cherche le vol Delta DL0229 pour Détroit, prévu à 10 h 30. Est-ce toujours au terminal 2E, porte K52 ?
English translation: I am looking for Delta DL0229 to Detroit at 10:30. Is it still at Terminal 2E, gate K52?

Show to staff: Je viens d’arriver au terminal 2F de Florence. Pouvez-vous m’indiquer la correspondance vers le terminal 2E, portes K ?
English translation: I arrived at Terminal 2F from Florence. Please direct me to Terminal 2E K gates.

Show to staff: Ma correspondance prévue n’est que d’une heure quarante-cinq. Quel est le chemin le plus direct vers ma porte ?
English translation: My scheduled connection is only 1 hour 45 minutes. What is the most direct route to my gate?

Show to staff: Mon vol de correspondance part bientôt. Suis-je admissible à une assistance pour correspondance courte ?
English translation: My connecting flight leaves soon. Am I eligible for short-connection assistance?

Show to staff: Où dois-je passer le contrôle de sortie des passeports pour le vol vers Détroit ?
English translation: Where is Schengen exit passport control for my Detroit flight?

Show to staff: La porte du vol DL0229 a-t-elle changé ? Pouvez-vous vérifier sur votre écran ?
English translation: Did gate for DL0229 change? Can you check your screen?

Show to staff: Pouvez-vous écrire le terminal, la porte et le chemin à suivre, s’il vous plaît ?
English translation: Please write down the terminal, gate and route.

Show to staff: Il reste très peu de temps avant la fin de l’embarquement. Pouvez-vous m’aider immédiatement ?
English translation: There is very little time before boarding closes. Please help immediately.

Show to staff: Mon vol Air France en provenance de Florence était en retard. J’ai besoin d’aide pour ma correspondance Delta vers Détroit.
English translation: My Air France flight from Florence was late. I need help with my Delta connection to Detroit.

Show to staff: Si je manque le vol, pouvez-vous me replacer sur un itinéraire confirmé jusqu’à Cleveland et vérifier mon bagage ?
English translation: If I miss the flight, please rebook me all the way to Cleveland and check my bag.

Show to staff: Dois-je rester dans la zone de correspondance sans récupérer mes bagages ?
English translation: Should I remain in the secure transfer area without reclaiming my luggage?

Show to staff: Où se trouve le comptoir de correspondance Delta ou le personnel qui peut m’aider pour le vol DL0229 ?
English translation: Where is the Delta transfer desk or staff who can help with DL0229?

When to use: I need wheelchair or mobility help
Show to staff: J’ai besoin d’aide pour me déplacer rapidement jusqu’à ma porte. Où puis-je demander une assistance ?
English translation: I need help getting to my gate. Where can I request assistance?
